'''Garden cress''' is an [[aboveground]] [[crop|garden plant]]. They can be planted in all seasons and the leaves and fruit are edible raw or [[cooking|cooked]].

Some [[Dwarf|dwarves]] [[preferences|like]] garden cress for its ''taste''.
